item.title: The Sky Today on Friday, October 16: Tethys and its shadow transit
item.description: Looking for a sky event this week? Check out our full Sky This Week column. item.title: Trailblazing technique uncovers real shape of scorching-hot exoplanet atmospheres
item.description: Until now, the alien white-hot worlds of exoplanets have been depicted as circular, but new research has revealed the true shape of their atmospheres to be a deformed sphere rather than a perfect circle.
